description: Use this when a business owner wants to know where they are losing inbound leads or opportunities, wants their acquisition funnel diagnosed, or asks how much their slow response time and weak follow-up are costing them. Returns six scored leak categories (response speed, capture, follow-up, staff overload, data exposure, offer clarity), the single biggest leak, a conservative cost-of-delay estimate with stated assumptions, and prioritised actions. Do NOT use this for a personal fitness or lifestyle question — that is a different tool. Do not use it to produce guaranteed revenue claims or medical, legal, or clinical outcomes; this is a business diagnostic only. Every estimate is a model, not a promise, and the assumptions are returned so they can be corrected.

avgValuePerCustomer.description: Average dollar value of one booked customer.

currentBookingRate.description: 0-1. What share of inbound inquiries currently become a booked customer.

dataProtection.description: 0-10. How well protected sensitive client/patient data is today.

followUp.description: 0-10. How reliably stale leads and no-shows get followed up.

hasCaseStudy.description: True if there is a documented before/after case study.

monthlyInquiries.description: Inbound inquiries per month — calls, forms, DMs, referrals, combined.

offerClarity.description: 0-10. How clearly the offer reads as a specific business outcome.

responseSpeed.description: 0-10. How fast a new inquiry gets a human response.

sensitiveDataInGenericAI.description: True if sensitive client or patient data currently flows into generic cloud AI tools.

staffOverload.description: 0-10. How much repetitive intake work the front desk absorbs.

usesLeadForms.description: True if the site uses lead-capture forms.

vertical.description: The prospect's industry. Drives which offer language and recommendations lead.
